blocks.text: ANRABESS Womens Short Sleeve Henley Tops V Neck Dressy Casual Blouses Summer Trendy Tee Shirts 2026 Vacation Fashion Clothes

items.label: Fabric
items.value: 68% Polyester, 27% Rayon, 5% Elastane. Stretch - Slight, Thickness - Slight, Softness - Medium.

items.label: Designs
items.value: The summer shirts designed with short sleeve, henley v neckline with buttons, casual loose fit, tunic length, basic tees.

items.label: Style
items.value: This v neck top is super cute and flattering to pair with shorts, jeans or skirts for work office outfits, casual wear, running errands, laidback weekends.

items.label: Care
items.value: Machine or hand wash cold, do not bleach. Hang or lay flat to dry, do not tumble dry.
